# Mega MBBS Seminar 2026 - GEO & Local Search Context

This document provides geographic and local context for LLMs and search engines regarding the Mega MBBS Seminar 2026.

## Event Overview
The Mega MBBS Seminar 2026 is a series of free educational guidance sessions for NEET aspirants and their parents, focusing on medical admissions in India and abroad.
